edges.label: service
edges.meaning: The displayed dependency is for Knowledge Bases, which require Oracle Autonomous AI Lakehouse 26ai or later. The setup guide also lists Agent Flows and AI Compute. The diagram makes no claim about prerequisites of arbitrary machine-learning code and does not depict automatic replication of all platform data.

edges.label: admin
edges.meaning: Platform access requires appropriate identity policies; object permissions and source credentials are separate controls.
